prompts.name: Мекка
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: SALAH app architectural wallpaper, full-bleed landscape 1536 x 1024, 3:2. A newly created photographic-style artistic illustration of the named real landmark, not a poster. Authentic restrained travel photography, fine natural stone texture, realistic non-fictional architecture, natural daylight and soft blue sky with a few wispy clouds. Composition engineered for both tablet and tall phone crops: the defining landmark MUST sit in the central 28% of image width (x 550..986 at 1536 pixels); keep every defining dome and minaret within the central 30% width. Buildings and landscape predominantly in lower half; upper 40% unobstructed quiet sky for app weather, no decorative framing. Peripheral buildings may be cropped on a phone but the identifying landmark must remain. Realistic proportions and distant camera position, subtle warm stone and cool sky, high-quality editorial image. No drawn Sun or Moon in the sky (the app adds astronomical objects), no text overlay, no logos or watermarks, no imaginary calligraphy or readable invented religious quotations, no ornate border, no fake UI. No nearby faces or identifiable people. No gold-glowing fantasy or CGI. Main subject: the Kaaba in Masjid al-Haram, Mecca. An accurate single black stone cuboid clothed in black kiswah with the recognizable restrained gold embroidered band near its top and gold door on its actual facade, not a mosque with a dome. Three-quarter view from the open white marble courtyard; Kaaba exactly at image center, about 240 pixels wide and 200 pixels high, its top around y 550 and base around y 750. The bright white real arcaded multi-level mosque is behind it at y 530..720, two slender pale mosque minarets at x 635 and x 900 extending up to y 310..400. Far surrounding urban towers may appear at far edges, no invented towers or domes. Tiny distant pilgrims only as soft, indistinct background scale, foreground largely unobstructed white marble. Frame respectfully and calmly; Kaaba's edges and black/gold identity clear, golden embroidery not rendered as legible text.

nightPrompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: supplied SALAH daytime wallpaper. Change ONLY time of day and ambient lighting to beautiful natural deep blue night. Preserve EXACT camera position, canvas ratio and dimensions, horizon, framing, physical shapes, coordinates, every building/dome/minaret/arch/Kaaba edge and the terrain. No camera movement, no resize, no new objects. Keep the named landmark completely unchanged and just relight it. A midnight indigo sky with very faint cloud texture; NO visible astronomical Moon or Sun, no star spray (the app overlays celestial bodies). Authentic restrained warm lighting on built structures if present, soft cool moonless ambient light and subtle rock visibility for the mountain. No invented neon outlines, no fantasy glowing golden dome, no text overlay or new lettering, no watermark. The Kaaba must remain black, Medina's dome GREEN, Al-Aqsa's dome grey, Mount Uhud red-brown. Do not add/remove pilgrims, umbrellas, columns, trees or architectural details. Night counterpart precisely aligned with day for a smooth opacity crossfade. Full bleed to all edges.
